content.title: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals promotes Fiona Sharp to CFO, secretary
content.summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals (BDRX) announced the promotion of Fiona Sharp to CFO and Company Secretary along with her election to the Board of Directors of the Company with immediate effect. Sharp is a senior finance professional having joined the Company as Group Financial Controller in December 2019. During her tenure, she has consistently broadened her remit to include many of the responsibilities of a CFO.
